w2:textbox.label:
1. Click the button below.
2. Verify that a popup is generated.
3. Click the close button on the popup.
4. Verify that the function specified with the closeAction option is executed.
(See the Script tab for detailed script.)

/// Sample Code

scwin.closeAction = function(id, info) {
   if (!info.isCloseButtonClick) {
       return true;
   }
   alert("To be closed by scwin.closeAction...");
   return true;
};
